summary: Iter-23 launch-readiness bug hunt on preview URL. Backend pytest suite (20 tests, /app/backend/tests/test_launch_readiness.py): 19/20 PASS. Frontend Playwright drive of Founding-Member reservation modal on /pricing, DevBypassToggle on /admin/dev, legal pages, footer, home, /join, /cellar-journal, and 404 fallback. Reservation flow WORKS end-to-end: modal opens on 'Enter The Press' CTA (once theme-suggestion toast dismissed), title correctly reads 'The Press · Monthly'/'The Press · Annual' reflecting page toggle, slot counter shows 'X of 99 spots claimed — Y left', all 6 tier×cycle combinations reserve successfully via tRPC (foundingMembers.reserve returns {ok:true, slotNumber, cap:99, emails}), getReservationCount increments, listReservations (owner-only) returns the new lead with iamrjpurr@gmail.com present. Real reservation submitted via UI landed slot #10 with correct 'SLOT #10 OF 99' + 'You're in the club' success state. HTML5 form validation catches invalid email + empty required fields. DevBypassToggle card + status pill + duration + enable button all render on /admin/dev; runtime bypass toggles ON via tRPC (admin.setDevBypass returns {ok:true, runtime:{active:true, expiresAt}}), and runtime-active indicator element appears in DOM. Env-forced-ON messaging is correctly displayed ('Env var is forcing bypass ON. Set ENABLE_DEV_BYPASS=false in prod to lock down'). SEO: /api/sitemap.xml valid urlset, /api/cellar-journal/rss.xml valid feed, /api/robots.txt present. LIP Audit Pack PDF: 200 %PDF for vintage=2026, 400 for vintage=abc. Legal pages /privacy, /terms, /refund all render real content (not placeholders). /cellar-journal index has 53 entry links. /join renders 'YOU'VE BEEN INVITED TO OWNOLOGY' headline. /admin/settings loads without 500. SPA 404 shows proper 'Page Not Found' component.

minor.issue: Returns HTML 200 (SPA fallback) instead of JSON 404. Spec requires /api/* unknowns to return 404 JSON. Root cause: Express catch-all SPA middleware in server/index.ts is registered before an API 404 handler.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does NOT close the modal — spec explicitly required. Verified on both fresh modal and success-state modal. No keydown listener exists in the component (only backdrop onClick).

Home page has NO <footer> element and NO links to /privacy, /terms, or /refund anywhere on the page. Spec: 'legal pages … be linked from the footer. Check the footer on the Home page links to each.' Warm-list winemaker has no way to reach legal pages from the landing page — potential compliance blocker for GDPR/AU Privacy Act.

ui_bugs.component: Pricing page — Founding Member banner vs modal counter
ui_bugs.issue: Founding-Member banner on /pricing shows '0 of 99 founding spots claimed / 99 SPOTS REMAINING' (uses paid-only count) while the reservation modal counter shows '10 of 99 spots claimed — 89 left' (uses paid+reserved). Inconsistent scarcity messaging for warm-list winemakers on the same page. Recommend both use the same getReservationCount total.

ui_bugs.component: Pricing page — 'Theme Suggestion' toast overlays CTA
ui_bugs.issue: A 'Try Soft Cellar for now?' theme-suggestion toast pops up over the Founding Member CTAs on first visit and covers the 'Enter The Press' button until dismissed. Playwright had to dismiss it to click through. Warm-list first-visit conversion risk.

issues: Theme-suggestion toast overlay may cover primary CTAs on first visit
No footer / no links to legal pages

action_items: P1 — Add Escape-key close to FoundingReservationModal (useEffect + document.addEventListener('keydown', esc→onClose) while open).
P1 — Add a global footer with /privacy /terms /refund links on Home (and ideally site-wide) — compliance + trust signal for warm-list DMs.

P2 — Unify Founding-Member scarcity counter: pricing-page banner should use foundingMembers.getReservationCount (paid+reserved) same as the modal, or explicitly label the banner 'paid subscribers' vs the modal's 'slots claimed'.
P2 — Suppress or delay the 'Try Soft Cellar' theme-suggestion toast until user scrolls / interacts, so it doesn't cover Founding CTAs on first paint of /pricing.
P3 — Add an API 404 JSON handler in server/index.ts before the SPA catch-all so /api/* unknowns return 404 JSON, not the SPA HTML.
critical_code_review_comments: FoundingReservationModal.tsx (402 lines) — well-structured, single responsibility. Missing Escape handler is the only functional gap. Inline styles are extensive (~150 lines) — future refactor could extract to CSS module but not blocking.

server/routers.ts foundingMembers.reserve (lines 254-300) — correctly fail-open on Resend errors (email failure won't roll back the DB write), which is the right choice for warm-lead capture. Zod schema properly validates email + non-empty name/wineryName. tier/cycle enums default to safe values. Cross-tier reservation was verified — all 6 combinations write successfully.
server/routers.ts admin.setDevBypass (lines 582-595) — 24h cap enforced via Zod .max(1440). Owner-only via ownerProcedure. Good.

server/routers.ts admin.getDevBypassState — correctly composes effectiveActive = envActive || runtime.active, so a runtime toggle can't defeat an env-forced OFF in prod. Verified in UI copy 'Env var is forcing bypass ON'.

getReservationCount (line 240-244) returns {total, paid, reserved, cap} — but the pricing-page banner appears to only read `paid` while the modal reads `total`. This is the RCA for the counter inconsistency listed under UI bugs.
Persistent nit carried from iter-16: cellarBrief.history pagination duplicate wineryId AND clause. Out of scope.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (reservation flow + admin/dev + legal pages + cellar-journal + join + 404 all work; 3 medium UI issues: no Escape close, no home footer, banner-vs-modal counter mismatch, toast covers CTA)

rca of the issue: 1) Escape close: FoundingReservationModal.tsx has no useEffect(document.addEventListener('keydown')) — only backdrop onClick handles close. Fix ~10 lines. 2) Footer: Home.tsx has no <footer> render. A shared Footer component appears to exist elsewhere but isn't mounted in the Home layout — either mount it in App layout or in Home.tsx. 3) Counter mismatch: pricing page banner uses foundingMembers.getCount (paid) whereas modal uses foundingMembers.getReservationCount (paid+reserved). Unify to getReservationCount total for consistent scarcity messaging. 4) API 404: In server/index.ts the express.static + SPA `res.sendFile('index.html')` catch-all runs before any /api 404 guard. Add `app.use('/api/*', (req, res) => res.status(404).json({error:'not_found'}))` before the SPA fallback.
